Deepened GitHub issue #1015 variant (one extra addition level, six live nested temporaries); the original and port now emit byte-exact output after the pool-expansion fix flapjack-pxn.2.5. Retained to show the fix generalizes past the four-register reserved pool.

GitHub issue #1015 previously-failing left-associative subtraction chain (five nested binary nodes); the original and port now emit byte-exact output after the flapjack-pxn.2.5 pool-expansion fix, extending coverage of the temporary-pool floor beyond the addition variants.

GitHub issue #1020 reproducer: CakeML riscv_ast Const lowering for 0x40000008 uses LUI+ADDI; the port now materializes all bits and this checked fixture is byte-exact. Broader constant/allocator coverage remains tracked by the listed beads.

Differential-fuzzing finding dup-global (GitHub issue #962 smoke): CakeML accepts a duplicate top-level global with the warning 'variable g is redeclared in top-level declaration' and keeps the later declaration; Flapjack previously rejected it in staticCheckDecls. Differential-fuzzing finding nomain-global (GitHub issue #962 smoke): the original CakeML pan_to_target synthesizes a main returning zero when the source has none, so a main-less program is accepted; Flapjack previously failed with 'entry not found'. Fixed by panTargetDeclarationsWithDefaultMain. Tracked by flapjack-pxn.8.5.14.3.

Multi-function callee argument/return ABI (GitHub issue #1024 / flapjack-pxn.8.5.10.1.1): this checked callee_abi fixture is now byte-exact with CakeML, including the ABI entry and return shape. Broader generated multi-function cases remain tracked by flapjack-8tb.4.

Relational-condition lowering (GitHub issue #1027 / flapjack-pxn.8.5.14.11): the checked fixture now emits byte-exact direct branches matching CakeML. Broader condition and long-range branch coverage remains tracked by the listed bead.

hello.pnk whole-artifact parity (GitHub issue #1022 / bead flapjack-8tb): the checked fixture now has byte-identical Cake and Flapjack output, including cml_main, after the Cake FFI setup-order fix. Retain it as the primary exact-output regression while broader accepted-program parity remains tracked by flapjack-8tb and child beads.

Pre-loop local retention through a while loop (bead flapjack-8tb.1): `var out = 7;` assigned before `while i < 2 { i = i + 1; }` and read by `return out` must keep the assignment. The original CakeML emits the constant and returns it (cml_main = 00706513 00006593 00206613 00c5d663 00158593 ff5ff06f 0080006f fedff06f 00008067, 36 bytes); the port previously dropped the assignment (ori a0,zero,0). The comparison lowering now threads the incoming loop live set through `loopCompileExp` (crep_to_loopScript.sml comparison case; f93a590f), so the assignment survives.
